basis: Vitreoretinal disease, skeletal dysplasia and sensorineural hearing loss are core Stickler features; hearing impairment occurs in 8/8 reported patients.

decisions.otologic: primary: sensorineural hearing loss is a core diagnostic feature of this Stickler subtype, present in 8/8 patients.

basis: Dysmyelination establishes neurologic disease; jaundice of unspecified mechanism does not establish hepatic injury.

decisions.hepatic: none: jaundice alone cannot distinguish hepatic dysfunction from hemolysis or isolated bilirubin handling abnormalities; liver damage is unestablished.

basis: Cerebellar hypoplasia and intellectual disability define disease; strabismus and muscle atrophy each occur in 30-79%, but direct ocular or muscle pathology is unestablished.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus occurs in 30-79% but does not establish direct ocular damage; cataract and visual abnormalities occur in 5-29%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: muscle atrophy occurs in 30-79%, but this cerebellar disorder does not establish direct myopathy rather than secondary disuse or neurologic effects.

basis: Skeletal and renal dysplasia define syndrome; pancreatic/palatal malformations occur in 80-99% and annotated myelodysplasia in 30-79%; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.

decisions.haematologic: involved: the supplied HPO annotation explicitly reports myelodysplasia in 30-79%, supporting marrow pathology, although the unusual association lowers confidence.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: pancreatic cystic abnormalities and cleft palate occur in 80-99%; these are additional structural manifestations of the skeletal-renal syndrome.

basis: Neurodevelopmental and skeletal abnormalities define syndrome; damaging ocular anomalies and heart defects each occur in 30-79%. Common dental shape variants need not impair function.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: congenital heart abnormalities are annotated in 30-79% and represent direct structural cardiac disease.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: talon cusps/high palate (80-99%) need not impair function; caries (30-79%) is secondary dental disease rather than direct syndromic damage.

basis: Vascular endothelial neoplasm characteristically arising in dermis or subcutis; rare metastases do not support additional organs.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: dermis and subcutis are the characteristic sites of origin of Dabska tumor.

basis: Peroxisomal metabolic disorder; neurologic, hepatic and retinal damage each affect >30%. Sensorineural hearing loss also commonly exceeds 30%, omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.ocular: involved: retinal degeneration commonly exceeds 30% across Zellweger spectrum; potentially profound visual loss supports retaining it under the cap.
decisions.otologic: none under cap: sensorineural hearing loss commonly exceeds 30%, but neurologic, hepatic and severe retinal disease occupy the available axes.

basis: Site-unspecified carcinoma morphology provides no assignable organ; the separately named lung subtype does not establish pulmonary origin for the umbrella.

decisions.pulmonary: none: the definition specifies histology without an anatomical origin; one pulmonary child does not establish the site of the generic concept.

basis: Thoracic and limb skeletal dysplasia; cerebellar malformation occurs in 3/4 with developmental delay in 3/3. Small pituitary in 2/4 lacks documented endocrine dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: small pituitary occurs in 2/4, but hypoplasia alone does not demonstrate impaired hormone production or other endocrine dysfunction.

basis: Inherited lung cancer susceptibility establishes future risk, without existing pulmonary disease or organ damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: predisposition to a later lung malignancy does not establish current pulmonary occupation, dysfunction or injury.
